name: @papercusp/image-blankness
description: Generic zero-dependency detector for a BLANK image capture — a screenshot that was written successfully but carries no visual content (uniform fill, smooth gradient, fully transparent). Decodes 8-bit non-interlaced PNG with node:zlib only and reports distinct-colour, dominant-colour and adjacent-pixel detail statistics. Deliberately fail-open: anything it cannot decode is reported 'undecodable', never 'blank', so a caller can reject only on a confident negative.
